# Revate AI

> Revate AI is an AI automation and web development agency based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. We build AI voice receptionists, chatbots, n8n workflow automations, custom websites, and UI/UX designs around business workflows.

Canonical website: https://www.revateai.com/

## Services

- [AI voice receptionists](https://www.revateai.com/#ai-voice-receptionists): Call handling, common questions, appointment booking, and handoffs to a team.
- [Workflow automation](https://www.revateai.com/#workflow-automation): Connect CRMs, email, forms, and other supported tools through n8n workflows.
- [AI chatbots](https://www.revateai.com/#ai-chatbots): Business information, lead capture, customer support, and escalation.
- [Custom web development](https://www.revateai.com/#web-development): Responsive business websites with clear enquiry journeys and technical SEO foundations.
- [UI/UX design](https://www.revateai.com/#ui-ux-design): User journeys, prototypes, and interface design.
